stories.title: HPD: Man critically injured in southeast Houston shooting
stories.summary: A man was taken to the hospital in critical condition after a shooting in southeast Houston. Police say the suspects left the scene on foot.

stories.title: Houston increases homebuyer assistance to $75,000 as housing market faces challenges
stories.summary: Houston is increasing financial assistance for eligible homebuyers as city leaders look to expand homeownership opportunities amid a challenging housing market.

stories.title: Harris County Sheriff's Office prepares for ICE agreement under new Texas law
stories.summary: The Harris County Sheriff's Office said it intends to comply with a new state law requiring an ICE partnership.

stories.title: 'I just heard a pop' | Neighbors react after 8-month-old baby shot in northwest Houston
stories.summary: Advocates say the shooting is another reminder about properly handling and storing firearms.

stories.title: Portillo's has closed these three locations in the Houston area
stories.summary: The Chicago-based restaurant confirmed to KHOU 11 that three of them were closed Nov. 15.

stories.title: Pilot charged in deadly 2024 Houston Ship Channel collision
stories.summary: A ship pilot faces a federal charge alleging his negligence caused a 2024 Houston Ship Channel collision that killed Aquarius Lowman.

stories.title: Nearly 300 people charged in South Texas immigration, border enforcement cases between Nov. 6-12
stories.summary: Federal prosecutors said 297 people face charges in South Texas immigration and border enforcement cases filed Nov. 6-12.

stories.title: 1 dead in crash involving 18-wheeler near Westpark Tollway in Cinco Ranch area
stories.summary: Multiple roads were shut down in the area. It's unclear what led up to the crash.

stories.title: Deadly shooting at Katy-area Airbnb prompts new security measures, concerns from neighbors
stories.summary: One man was killed and another injured during a party at a short-term rental in the Windstone Colony neighborhood.

stories.title: 8-month-old accidentally shot inside northwest Harris County apartment, deputies say
stories.summary: An 8-month-old is expected to survive after being accidentally shot by the child's father at a Harris County apartment, according to investigators.

stories.title: New Texas A&M rules limit where e-scooters can go on campus
stories.summary: Texas A&M will bar e-scooters from main campus sidewalks and parking lots on Jan. 1 and add safety rules for all micromobility riders.

stories.title: Pct. 6 Constable's Office dispatcher involved in deadly road rage shooting on Highway 90, HCSO says
stories.summary: A 35-year-old man was shot and killed during a road rage incident on Highway 90 in Crosby. HCSO says the shooter works for a constable's office.
